# Castel Sant'Angelo Tickets

> > Official ticket booking platform for Castel Sant'Angelo in Rome, offering fast-track admission to Hadrian's historic mausoleum-turned-papal fortress.

This site provides comprehensive visitor information for Castel Sant'Angelo, one of Rome's most iconic monuments. It covers ticket purchasing, historical background from its origins as Emperor Hadrian's mausoleum through its transformation into a papal fortress, architectural details, interior highlights, and practical visitor guidance including nearby dining options.
